svg.text: Figure 6 - Controller pipeline, one request end to end
Five control stages, then the data path. All the arithmetic is in S0 so that S1 - the stage that must fire every single cycle - is only a mux.
S0 runs one cycle AHEAD, speculatively
If it ran in the same cycle as S1, the timing comparisons would be on the
critical path and 1 GHz would not close.
Pool empty and row already open?
E1 feeds S1 directly, skipping 2 cycles.
Idle read latency budget: 1 (NHI) + 2 (decode) + 2 (arb) + 3 (to DRAM) + 16 (tRCD=0 on a row hit, + CL) + 4 (back) + 2 (ECC) + 2 (respond) = 32 clocks = 32 ns
Only 9 of those 32 clocks belong to the controller. The rest is DRAM and PHY physics.
